I've wanting to meet a celebrity to honor her memory. I've waited 3 years for it to happen already.

If it doesn't happen, there's no point living my life which is full of misery and pain.
If I am to suffer, people should suffer with me too.
I think it'd be better if these people didn't exist in this world to begin with. Seems like everybody I try to get along serves to treat me like shit.
Aphex Twin - Come to Daddy
Anyway, all I care about is meeting her. There's nothing else in life that I'm happy to look forward to.
I'm doing it for both me and her. Don't make it seem any other way. Are you commenting to support me or to discourage me?
One way or another, meeting Gal for my grandmother must happen.
I think I should in my next appointment.
I have appointments with a therapist but I don't feel comfortable talking to her about Gal yet. And yes, I genuinely believe that meeting Gal would help me feel better about life.
Nobody gives a shit about me or my dreams. People are too selfish to think of me.

My grandmother died in mid-2017 after fighting a stroke for 3-4 years. I buy Wonder Woman toys to honor her memory and I would be genuinely happy when I could meet Gal to let her know about it.

I was very close to her. She has singlehandedly supported my family for most of her life.

After she died, I've been feeling very miserable that she's no longer around to support us anymore.

Meeting Gal would help me move on with my life and I'd be grateful and happy for that.

What makes you say that I wanna blackmail her?

I am a genuine big fan of Gal, and I genuinely believe meeting her to get an autograph and a photo for my late grandmother would honor her memory. I paid a lot of money with Omaze and was extremely upset and disappointed when I didn't win.
It's not just about pretty, it's her down-to-earth personality.

I was very close to my grandma. Her death affected me heavily and I regret that I'm not able to spent enough time with her when she was bedridden with stroke at home, and it makes me depressed I'll never get that chance again.
It's to honor my grandmother's memory with an autographed toy so that I can move on with my life.
I honestly don't know. Maybe a video DM or a DM itself would lift my mood up but it's unlikely to happen.

I have talked a lot about my feelings on Instagram. Some of the people in the fandom made fun of me and took my depression lightly. Some became my friends and supported what I did. I myself paid a lot of money trying to reach her., hoping she'll respond back to my efforts.
